name: Project Neon
summary: This Gorilla Tag fangame brings the same adrenaline-fueled movement you love with a fresh twist. Run, jump, climb, and swing using only your hands as you race through custom maps designed for tag, minigames, and free play. Whether you’re escaping a lava monkey, exploring new environments, or competing with friends, every match is pure chaos and excitement. With community-driven updates, new game modes, and a focus on fun, this fangame offers a unique spin while keeping the spirit of Gorilla Tag alive.
